description: Every sentence a wait is said in. delivery_state.waits fills each from the fields it derives, in journal_words' template forms; no view words a wait itself. A template may instead be {"by": field, "cases": {value: template}, "otherwise": template}.

stages.description: Where the story a wait names stands, by its stage in the record.

cases.handed: It waits for the lead to accept it.
cases.checked: It is checked and about to merge.

waits.description: A story's wait, by its cause.

templates.files: Waits for {on:ticket} to land. {onLane:lane} holds {files:list} for it.
templates.review: In review: round {round} under way at {head:commit}, {back} of {lenses:count:lens|lenses} back.

cases.lead: The lead's {work} waits for delivery {holder}, which is {doing}[, since {at}].

slot.otherwise: {waiter:ticket} waits for delivery {holder}, which is {doing}[, since {at}].

lanes.description: A lane's own sentences: an idle lane whose next story waits, by that story's cause, and a lane waiting on another story to land.

templates.order: {subject:lane} is next on {next:ticket}, which waits for {on:ticket} to land.

cases.true: {subject:lane} is next on {next:ticket}, which waits for delivery {peer}, whose {story:ticket} claims {files:list}.

claim.otherwise: {subject:lane} is next on {next:ticket}, which waits for delivery {peer}, which claims {files:list}.

templates.files: {subject:lane} is next on {next:ticket}, which waits for {on:ticket} to land. {onLane:lane} holds {files:list} for it.
templates.held: {subject:lane} is next on {next:ticket}, which the lead holds: {text}
templates.waiting: {subject:lane} waits for {on:ticket} to land[ before it finishes {own:ticket}].

holding.description: Under the story others wait on.

templates.claim: Delivery {peer}'s {story:ticket} waits on this delivery's claim on {files:list}.

doing.description: What a command holds or waits for a merge slot to do, as its holder and waiter files say: a holder's as it goes on, a lead's waiter's as its work. A file without it is using the main line.

needsYou.description: What "Needs you" says: the two forms a wait reaches it in, the item for a stopped story no other item names, and each row's headline, why, what clears it and who acts, by the item's kind, with the list's heading, opening sentence, holding mark and age, and the heading of what a closed delivery left open.

templates.free: {subject:ticket} is free to start. {lane:lane} is idle.

cases.trackerLag: The tracker is behind the record
cases.trackerLedger: A tracker update needs a hand
cases.healthRunning: The full health run is under way[ at {head:commit}]
cases.healthFailed: The full health run failed at {head:commit}
cases.healthFlaky: Flaky tests failed the full health run at {head:commit}
cases.baseFocused: The main line is broken, under the focused posture
cases.report: A report for the lead[ on {about}]

cases.healthRunning: The close waits for its result.
cases.healthFlaky: [{tests:list} failed, then passed alone, so ]the main line isn't broken.
cases.baseFocused: It holds nothing under the focused posture on {source}, and serve still waits for base.repaired.
cases.unaccepted: Its checkout is kept until the lead decides.
cases.drafts: The merge step refuses drafts, and the lead may not mark them ready.

cases.trackerLag: Clears when the publisher posts them on a later pass.
cases.trackerLedger: Stays listed for the friction note.
cases.healthRunning: Clears when the run ends, or with lead-close, which stops it.
cases.healthFailed: Clears with a pass at a later base head, or lead-resolve full-health.
cases.healthFlaky: Clears with a full health pass at a later base head.
cases.baseBroken: Clears with base.repaired in the journal.
cases.baseHealth: Clears with a full health pass at a later base head, or base.repaired in the journal.
cases.baseFocused: Clears with base.repaired in the journal, or a full health pass once the base returns to gate.
cases.runnerHold: Clears when the queue's hold clears, with base.repaired, or with lead-resolve {entry}.
cases.listener: Clears when the lead is watching again.
cases.drafts: Clears when each is marked ready, then lead-accept --requeue for one that stopped.
cases.laneAsks: Clears when {lane:lane} no longer waits on {whom}.
cases.regrant: Clears when the lead regrants the lines or revokes the claim.
cases.laneOutside: Clears when the branch no longer changes it, or the lead grants it.
cases.laneUnreadable: Clears with a pass that reads the branch.
cases.stopped: Clears when {subject:ticket} is put back, lands or settles.
cases.free: Clears when {subject:ticket} is assigned, held, or waits again.
cases.paused: Clears when the lead lifts the hold.
cases.report: Clears when the report leaves the record.

cases.empty: Nothing needs anyone, and nothing is holding up the finish.
cases.none: {parts:list}. Nothing is holding up the finish.
cases.it: {parts:list}, and it's holding up the finish.
cases.all: {parts:list}, and all of them are holding up the finish.
cases.one: {parts:list}, and 1 of them is holding up the finish.

summary.otherwise: {parts:list}, and {holding} of them are holding up the finish.

templates.heading: Waiting on someone

listening.description: The "Needs you" item while no lead-wait runs and something needs the lead to listen: the lanes still at work, by name, the first as a sentence starts it.

cases.0: A piece in the queue can't reach the lead. If it lands or stops, nothing will tell the lead until it is watching again.
cases.1: {lanes:list} can't reach the lead. A hand-off or question from it will wait unseen until the lead is watching again.

text.otherwise: {lanes:list} can't reach the lead. A hand-off or question from them will wait unseen until the lead is watching again.
